_comment: Versioning matrix for nano-zyrkel binary + WASM cores. Consumed by the update-core reusable workflow in user repos to decide whether an update is safe to apply automatically. Read https://github.com/schlein-lab/nano-zyrkel/blob/main/docs/architecture.md for the full versioning policy.

v0.1.0.notes: Initial workspace refactor. Library + thin CLI separation, Plugin trait introduced. CLI surface unchanged from monolithic v0.x.

Initial wasm-core release. Data layer (DataLoader, Filter, Aggregator, Stats, Search, Diff, Cache, Retry) plus Config + I18n. Visualization layer with basic charts (LineChart, BarChart, Donut, Tooltip), advanced (ScatterPlot, Histogram, Heatmap, SortedBar, Legend, EmptyState) and spatial (LinearTrack, NetworkGraph, WorldMap).
